prompts.a:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production 2D game sprite-part atlas, four rows by five columns.
Input image: the single attached image is the EDIT TARGET, not a style reference.
Primary request: make a surgical cleanup of the painted attachment joints only. Remove ALL circular shoulder sockets on the four body sprites in column 1, and ALL ellipse end-cap outlines, oval rings, disks, glossy connector knobs, and contrasting connector patches at the TOP of EVERY detached arm and leg in columns 2 through 5. Replace each shoulder socket with smooth continuous adjacent costume/fur/body color and natural texture: NO circle, hole, outline, seam, or circular bulge. At each detached limb's top, continue the existing sleeve/fur/material smoothly to a FLAT top silhouette as though the limb has simply been cropped from a longer limb. There must be NO visible oval top face, ring, disk, inset edge, cap or connector. Keep the limb full length, preserving its original topmost extent. Keep top widths approximately identical to the shaft below. Every detached limb remains straight.
Invariants: preserve EXACTLY the 1402 by 1122 canvas, four rows and five columns, every character identity, every part, all original cell positions, part centers, proportions, overall sizes, faces, clothing, colors, hands, fingers, feet, cuffs, shoes, fur stripes, tails and original crisp cartoon shading. Column 1 has the original four head+torso bodies; columns 2 and 3 their detached left and right arms; columns 4 and 5 their detached left and right legs. Do not add or remove any part. Do not reposition or combine parts. Change only the unwanted attachment marks and local boundary needed for flat tops. Preserve the uniform vivid GREEN background, not transparency; all empty space must remain the same vivid green with no debris, ghosts, text or shadows. This is a natural character sprite-part atlas, never doll/toy components. The shapes must assemble seamlessly.
Specific cleanup: Characters, top to bottom: smiling mustached Kuwaiti man in white dishdasha and white ghutra; woman in teal hijab and dress with gold embroidery; smiling boy in white dishdasha; girl in purple hijab and embroidered dress. On teal and purple bodies, erase the little shoulder oval bumps completely and restore clean continuous shoulders. Remove all white, teal, and purple oval endcap outlines on all 16 detached limbs.

prompts.c_restore:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the cleaned 1402×1122 green sprite atlas.
Input Image 2 is ONLY A DETAIL REFERENCE for the original antenna decorations on the two upper-left character heads.
Make only TWO tiny local restorations in Image 1:
1. Restore the robot's single short light gray/silver antenna stalk and turquoise spherical tip above the center of its head, matching Image 2 exactly in position, scale, shape, outline and shading. The robot is row 1 column 1.
2. Restore both pink spherical antenna tip bulbs on the ends of the alien's two existing antenna stalks, matching Image 2 exactly in position, scale, shape, outline and shading. The alien is row 2 column 1.
This is the entire requested change. The antenna balls are essential character HEAD accessories, not body or limb joints.
Preserve every other pixel and object of Image 1. Keep all cleaned body shoulders and all 16 cleaned detached limb tops exactly as in Image 1: smooth shoulders and flat seamless limb tops, NO shoulder circles, NO limb connector balls, NO oval endcaps. Do not reintroduce any of the old joints from Image 2. Do not move or resize anything. Preserve the exact four rows by five columns, all 20 parts, identities, expressions, costumes, limb proportions, hands, feet, cuffs, tails, robotic internal elbow and knee details, full crisp shading, all empty spaces and the uniform vivid GREEN background. No transparency or new objects beyond the three original antenna tip balls and robot antenna stalk. Exact original canvas size 1402×1122.

note: C required a second local edit to restore antenna details. Discard first C intermediate. No checkout files touched.
